1.w: Finally then, brothers, we ask and exhort you⁺ in the Lord Jesus that, just as you⁺ received from us how it is necessary for you⁺ to walk and to please God, just as also you⁺ walk, that you⁺ may abound more.

2.w: For you⁺ know what instructions we gave you⁺ through the Lord Jesus.

3.w: For this is the will of God—your⁺ sanctification: [for] you⁺ to abstain from sexual immorality;

4.w: [for] each of you⁺ to know [how] to possess his own vessel in sanctification and honor,

5.w: not in the passion of lust just as also the Gentiles, those not knowing God;

6.w: not to go beyond and to take advantage of his brother in the matter, because the Lord [is] avenging concerning all these things, just as also we said before to you⁺ and earnestly testified.

7.w: For God did not call us to impurity, but in sanctification.

8.w: So then, the one setting [this] aside does not set aside man but God, the One also giving His Holy Spirit to you⁺.

9.w: Now concerning brotherly love, you⁺ have no need [for one] to write to you⁺, for you⁺ yourselves are taught by God to love one another.

10.w: For also you⁺ are doing this to all the brothers, the ones in all Macedonia. But we exhort you⁺, brothers, to abound more,

11.w: and to strive earnestly to live quietly and to do your own [things], and to work with your⁺ own hands, just as we commanded you⁺,

12.w: so that you⁺ may walk properly toward those outside and may have need of no one.

13.w: But we do not want you⁺ to be ignorant, brothers, concerning those having fallen asleep, so that you⁺ should not be grieved, just as also the rest, those having no hope.

14.w: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, so also through Jesus God will bring with Him those having fallen asleep.

15.w: For this we say to you⁺ in the word of the Lord, that we the living, remaining unto the coming of the Lord, shall not precede those having fallen asleep,

16.w: because the Lord Himself with a loud command, with the voice of an archangel, and with the trumpet of God will descend from heaven, and the dead in Christ will rise first.

17.w: Then we, the living remaining, will be caught up together with them in the clouds for the meeting of the Lord in the air; and so we will be always with the Lord.

18.w: Therefore encourage one another in these words.
